concepts.summary: Open side mid zone from 2x2. Wanda means a box count: the line plus the tight end account for four down linemen and two linebackers. Tiff is Wanda with a Flinch. Insert is available.
concepts.qb: Open to the play side on the 4 or 8 o'clock line. Adjust on the second step. Carry out the keeper fake.
concepts.hb: Toes at seven and a half yards. Open with a lateral step and aim for the C gap. Press that spot, read the end man on the line and then the next defender inside. One cut, then go.
concepts.criteria: Can vs play side external pressure or a Palms look.

positions.OL: Box count, four down and two backers with the tight end. Combinations shown: Single, Gang, Lag, Swoop, Insert, Flinch, Corner.

alerts: Tiff is Wanda with a Flinch.
The diagrams show the can being used vs internal DB pressure.
concepts.can: Vs play side external pressure, Palms, or internal DB pressure.

concepts.summary: Open side mid zone from 3x1. Wanda means the box count. Wash is Wanda Push: the line still takes four down and two backers in the box and alerts a Push call to a free safety.
concepts.qb: Open to the play side on the 4 or 8 o'clock line. Adjust on the second step. Carry out the keeper fake.
concepts.hb: Toes at seven and a half yards. Open with a lateral step and aim for the C gap. Press that spot, read the end man on the line and then the next defender inside. One cut, then go.
concepts.criteria: Wanda: can when the safety support cannot be blocked or vs play side external pressure. Wash: can vs a four count or play side external pressure.

positions.OL: On Wash, Push call to the free safety. Combinations shown: Single, Gang, Money Thru, and Fan from the 12 personnel looks.

alerts: Wash adds the Push call to the free safety.
The diagrams show the can being used vs a four count.
concepts.can: Wanda: vs unblockable safety support or play side external pressure. Wash: vs a four count or play side external pressure.

concepts.summary: Open side mid zone with Fly motion toward the run side. The set starts 3x1 and ends 2x2. Line plus tight end account for four down and two backers. Flight is Fly with a late snap. Slalom (X-Slalom on the diagrams) is a tag for the receiver.
concepts.qb: Reverse out and handle the ball on the 4 or 8 o'clock line. Adjust on the second step. Carry out the keeper fake. From the gun, toes at five yards. Kick back and shuffle to clear the back's path, then carry out the keeper fake. The game plan may turn this into a pass set.
concepts.hb: Toes at seven and a half yards. Open with a lateral step and aim for the C gap. Press that spot, read the end man on the line and then the next defender inside. One cut, then go. From the gun, line up with the inside leg on the guard's outside leg, open laterally and aim for the B gap.
concepts.criteria: Can vs play side external pressure. Cat pressure adjustments come from the game plan.

positions.OL: Combinations shown: Single, Gang, Fan. On Slalom the line cannot give up penetration or the Slalom gets knocked off.

alerts: Flight means Fly motion, snapped late.
On Slalom, penetration kills the play. The line has to keep the front clean.
Cat pressure adjustments by game plan.

concepts.summary: Wanda with Flow motion. On a pre-snap read the ball can go to the receiver in Flow motion (the Spirit and Alaska plays). With the Sift tag the tight end sifts the backside and the back gets the ball. The line targets the second defender counting in from the sideline.
concepts.qb: Open to the play side on the 4 or 8 o'clock line and adjust on the second step. Give the ball deep. Carry out the keeper fake. From the gun, toes at five yards. Kick back and shuffle to clear the back's path, then carry out the keeper fake. The game plan may turn this into a pass set.
concepts.hb: Toes at seven and a half yards. Open with a lateral step and aim for the C gap. Press that spot, read the end man on the line and then the next defender inside. One cut, then go. From the gun, split the tackle's inside leg, open laterally and aim for the B gap.
concepts.criteria: Can vs a G bubble, play side external pressure, or a jam.

concepts.summary: Straight Sift mid zone to the closed edge. The line and tight end block the box by structure. The tight end goes Thru or Arc for the second defender in from the sideline, the play side receiver takes the first, and the line works to the third. Stress is an automatic sift, so the backside tackle must Sift or make a B call. Sub personnel only, not base. Use it against nickel.
concepts.qb: Open to the play side on the 4 or 8 o'clock line. Adjust on the second step. Carry out the keeper fake. From the gun, toes at five yards. Kick back and shuffle to clear the back's path, then carry out the keeper fake. The game plan may turn this into a pass set.
concepts.hb: Toes at seven and a half yards. Open with a lateral step and aim for the C gap. Press that spot, read the end man on the line and then the next defender inside. One cut, then go. From the gun, line up with the inside leg on the guard's outside leg, open laterally and aim for the B gap.
concepts.criteria: No check. Call it and run it.
